name: @pipeworx/mcp-montana-code

tools.name: mt_code_section
tools.description: Get the FULL TEXT of a section of the Montana Code Annotated — Montana state law — by citation. "MCA 45-5-102" is deliberate homicide. Returns the statutory text. Keyless. Use for "what does MCA 45-5-102 say" or to check a Montana statute a case relies on.

section.description: Section as cited, e.g. "45-5-102" (deliberate homicide) or "61-8-401" (DUI). Title-chapter-section.

tools.name: mt_code_search
tools.description: Search the Montana Code Annotated BY TOPIC or keyword rather than citation -- "computing time deadline holiday", "landlord security deposit", "deliberate homicide". Covers all 54 MCA titles, including Title 25 chapter 20, the Montana Rules of Civil Procedure (Rule 6 computing time is MCA 25-20-206). Returns ranked sections with citation, heading and an opening excerpt; call mt_code_section with a result's citation for the full text. Full-text match, not semantic search. A query with no hits returns found:false. Keyless.

query.description: Topic or keywords, e.g. "computing time period days holiday".

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-montana-code forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the montana-code pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
